blurb: Guests can enroll in dance classes with performances twice a year, or book birthday parties featuring a dance class, DJ party, and party room time. The studio emphasizes a positive, professional environment and requires proper dance attire and attendance for performances.
extraNote: $35 annual non-refundable registration fee per family · Tuition paid yearly or split into 10 monthly payments by auto debit · $100 non-refundable performance fee per class, payable in two installments · Attendance required for performances and dress rehearsals · Students missing more than 3 lessons during show prep may be evaluated for performance participation · No tolerance for drugs, alcohol, tobacco, bullying, or inappropriate behavior · Tuition must be current to participate in classes and performances · 30 days notice required to drop classes; accounts must be paid in full · September through June
